displayName: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via Native Utilities

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe", "wmic.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete", "shadows"))
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy", "delete"))
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("Win32_ShadowCopy", "Delete"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via Native Utilities
alertTemplate.description: Detects deletion of Windows Volume Shadow Copies via vssadmin, wmic or PowerShell to inhibit system recovery during ransomware or destructive post-exploitation activity. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1511. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques, acsc-2026-09-08-digital-camouflage-crypters-malware.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Isolate the affected host immediately and investigate parent processes for ransomware or destructive malware staging (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1511; Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques, acsc-2026-09-08-digital-camouflage-crypters-malware).
